svg.text: K3b WET COLUMN — gully, speed spindle S, blade post, corer nest, jet gate
Everything sits under the drum lip, which never moves: waste, water and food all fall here.
S: 600 W, 1.5 Nm, 0–6000 rpm through a closed thimble Ø 40
peel / core / stone: spit + sprung blade (1, 2.5, 5 mm shoes), corer nest
jets 85 °C · 2 mm strainer · no actuators except S
A GULLY + SPINDLE S under the drum lip (front section)

text.tspan: Drum pours wash water and peel over its lip: the strainer keeps the solids
Two 85 °C jets flush funnel, thimble and seat ring
The hand sets the cutter cup (bought discs, hopper lid) on S
Reverse helix screws pieces out one by one into the hopper; S slices them (1–6 mm)
The hand takes the cup away — the gully is free again

svg.text: S ware stands on a 3-point ring round the thimble; a magnet rotor drives it through its base:
B SPIT + SPRUNG BLADE: peel by turning (household apple-peeler principle)
hand Y traverses past the blade
Apple, pear, cucumber, citrus, kiwi, mango, pumpkin: 15–25 s per piece; peel falls into the strainer.
C CORER NEST: the hand presses a tube corer down (Z, 60–150 N)
stone fruit: cut round on the spit,
twisted apart in the nest, stone pitted
D FRONT OF THE COLUMN: jet gate · tap · waste chute
After every soiled grip the chuck goes through the jets; a soiled chuck may not grip clean ware.

g.text: 1/5 Wash water and peel slurry pour into the gully; the strainer keeps the solids, the pump takes the water
2/5 Before any S bowl stands in the gully: two 85 °C jets flush the funnel, the thimble and the seat ring
3/5 The hand stands the cutter cup on S — no shaft passes the wall, a magnet rotor turns the disc through the thimble
4/5 The drum turns backwards: its helix screws potatoes out one at a time into the hopper; 4 mm slices for Bratkartoffeln
5/5 Cup lifted away; peel, cores and scraps from the spit and the nest also fall into the strainer
